statement: Let X : V → {0, 1}d, and let 𝒯 be a locally k- connected hierarchy of G, with selected nonroot nodes T satisfying |O(t)| ≥ kλ|P(t)| for t ∈ T. Suppose ℱ1, . . . , ℱm is a λ-geometric sequence of families of (24C3/k)-assigned bags, of types (δi, Ti), with Ti ⊆ T. If C4 ≥ 3, λ ≤ 1 6C4 , C3 ≥ 2 ( (C4 + 1) + 4(C4 + 2)2) , then (B.44) ∑ {u,v}∈E ‖Xu − Xv‖1 ≥ k 8 C4 12C3 m ∑ i=1 δi ∑ t∈Ti | Bagt |. In particular, one may take C4 = 3, C3 = 104 and λ ≤ 1/18.
